name: Welcome Modal UI
description: Welcome modal DOM and interactions. Documents the modal overlay structure, branding header, recent workspaces list with existence checks and per-item remove buttons, action buttons, and visual states for open/closed modal and empty recent list.

dom.root: .modal-overlay (this.overlay) — full-screen fixed overlay, display:none by default

elements.welcome_modal: .welcome-modal (this.el) — centered dialog card, role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby=welcome-title
elements.welcome_head: .welcome-head — branding header section containing name and subtext
elements.welcome_sep: .welcome-sep — horizontal separator line (two instances: after head, before actions)
elements.recent_sep: .welcome-sep#welcome-recent-sep — separator before actions, hidden when recent is empty
elements.welcome_actions: .welcome-actions — button row at bottom of modal
elements.close_btn: button.welcome-btn-secondary#welcome-close — 'Close' button, click resolves Promise with null
elements.open_btn: button.welcome-btn#welcome-open — 'Open Workspace' button, triggers native directory picker

dynamic_elements.recent_item: .welcome-recent-item — per-workspace clickable row, contains path span and remove button
dynamic_elements.recent_path: .welcome-recent-item-path — displays workspace path text. Has .welcome-recent-item-missing class if path no longer exists on disk
dynamic_elements.recent_remove: .welcome-recent-item-remove — '×' button with aria-label='Remove {path} from recent', click with stopPropagation

interactions.name: open_workspace
interactions.action: IPC workspace:select → opens native OS directory picker dialog. If user selects a path, close(path) → resolve(path). If user cancels, picker returns null — Promise remains pending.
interactions.result: Workspace path selected and Promise resolves with the path

interactions.name: close_modal
interactions.trigger: click on #welcome-close button or Escape key press
interactions.action: close(null) → overlay display:none, remove Escape key listener, resolve(null). If window is closed via IPC window:close, the Promise is left unresolved.
interactions.result: Modal hidden, Promise resolves with null

interactions.name: select_recent
interactions.action: If path exists on disk (verified by fs:readDir check during open()), close(path) → resolve(path). Missing paths (.welcome-recent-item-missing class) do nothing on click.
interactions.result: Existing workspace path selected, modal closes and resolves path

interactions.name: remove_recent
interactions.action: e.stopPropagation() to prevent select_recent → IPC workspace:removeRecent(path) → remove .welcome-recent-item from DOM. If no items remain: hide .welcome-recent and #welcome-recent-sep (display:none).
interactions.result: Recent item removed from list; if list becomes empty, section hidden

interactions.name: escape_close
interactions.action: escHandler checks e.key === 'Escape' → close(null). Listener removed during close().

states.closed: Initial state. .modal-overlay display:none. No Escape key listener. Promise not yet created.
states.open: .modal-overlay display:flex. Escape key listener active. Recent workspaces loaded and rendered. Promise pending, resolves on close().
states.recent_empty: Sub-state of open: workspace:getRecent returns empty array. .welcome-recent and #welcome-recent-sep both set to display:none.
states.recent_loaded: Sub-state of open: workspace:getRecent returns non-empty array. Recent items rendered with existence checks. Missing paths get .welcome-recent-item-missing class.

lifecycle.destroyed_by: close() resolves Promise; overlay DOM remains in body but hidden. Each open() creates new Promise; class instance is not reused.
